description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ViewQuickTest' that tests the 'ViewQuick' class in the SuiteCRM application. It includes test methods that verify the instantiation and behavior of the ViewQuick object, including setup of related objects for rendering views.

classes.name: ViewQuickTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ViewQuick class in the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: testViewQuick
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of the ViewQuick class and verifies its type and options properties.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Sets up and tests rendering of the ViewQuick class with associated DetailView2, Sugar_Smarty, and bean objects, including exception handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including global current_user and configuration defaults.
